evidence.finding: Introduced Adaptive Visual Pipeline: Stage 1 YOLO+OCR/scene heuristics and Stage 2 Ollama VLM only when confidence/escalation rules required it.

Adaptation is runtime compute/escalation selection. Confidence/triggers route to VLM; statistics track routing/latency. No persistent user-scoped classifier/prototype update contract is implemented in this file.

Fast Stage-1 perception used YOLOv8n, Tesseract OCR, hard-coded scene rules, screenshot/photo/diagram heuristics and simple visual summaries. The inspected file exposes no personal familiarity-memory update state.
Deleted frank_visual_pipeline.py and frank_adaptive_vision.py and replaced them with unified FrankEye.

FrankEye merged Digital Retina v8 CNN weights, DINOv2, GOLPU-derived visual features, Tesseract and face detection. The CNN section is explicitly inference-only; it reuses a saved retina_v8.pt and fixed bio-inspired feature extraction rather than defining the current FRANK-0.1 user-adaptive candidate/promotion/rollback loop.
FrankEye screenshot path was further specialized; useless CIFAR-10 classification for screenshots was removed, preserving a negative result about generic classifier surfacing on UI imagery.
Migrated FrankEye consumers to tools/native_vision.py using Qwen3.5 native multimodal vision.
NativeVision is an image-to-base64 -> llama-server multimodal request bridge and explicitly replaces FrankEye; the inspected implementation contains no persistent personal learner state.
The frozen Level-0 head contains the same NativeVision blob as the March-31 introduction, so no later change to this main vision file added the FRANK-0.1 adaptive learner contract.

Drive Digital Retina history independently preserves learned k-means/centroid dictionary mechanisms, cached replay/miss iteration and realistic-negative calibration foundations that are absent from the inspected frozen Project-Frankenstein NativeVision mainline.

FRANK 0.1 fixes a user-scoped adaptive Micro Visual Classifier with trusted-example admission, open-set gating, bounded cyclic candidate updates, rollback/replay/versioning and UDB/ClayGraph persistence as a release requirement.
